name: scrawl
description: Minimalist desktop drawing overlay for Windows

scripts.pack: (taskkill /F /IM Scrawl.exe >nul 2>&1 || ver >nul) && node -e "setTimeout(()=>process.exit(),2000)" && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir && node -e "const {rcedit}=require('rcedit');rcedit('dist/win-unpacked/Scrawl.exe',{icon:'icon.ico'})"
